{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"bs-01","text":"公司业务以整车业务为核心，同时包含零部件、移动出行和服务、金融等业务板块，并通过板块协同支撑整车业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"bs-02","text":"主营业务分行业列示为汽车制造业与金融业；分产品列示为整车业务、零部件业务、劳务及其他、金融业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"]},{"fact_id":"bs-03","text":"公司零部件业务主要由下属控股子公司华域汽车系统股份有限公司开展。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0013"]},{"fact_id":"bs-04","text":"公司实施自主乘用车业务一体化管理，并对商用车业务实施扁平化管理，撤销商用车事业部并将职能整合并入上汽大通。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"ps-01","text":"整车业务为公司主要产品线，2025年整车销售450.7万辆；自主品牌集中推出全新MG4、荣威M7、尚界H5、智己全新LS6/LS9、五菱缤果S、大通大拿等新能源产品。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"整车销售","raw_value":"450.7","value":"450.7","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"ps-02","text":"公司与华为合作推出“尚界”品牌，2月签署战略合作协议，9月下旬投放首款产品尚界H5，并跻身国内15-20万元级市场主流产品阵营。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-03","text":"上汽大众、上汽通用分别推出AUDI E5、别克至境L7等中高端智电新品。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"ps-04","text":"公司通过推出多款HEV混动车型拓展海外市场，MG品牌在欧洲市场销量超过30万辆。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"MG品牌欧洲市场销量","raw_value":"超过30","value":"30","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"greater_than"}]},{"fact_id":"ps-05","text":"零部件板块完善智能电动化核心技术布局，推进固态电池、智能底盘等技术的产业化落地；金融板块加强汽车金融服务并拓展海外金融服务；移动出行和服务板块聚焦服务整车业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"ps-06","text":"公司已构建包含纯电、混动、氢能三大整车平台，以及电池、电驱、超混系统和智能车全栈解决方案的“七大技术底座”。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"]},{"fact_id":"ps-07","text":"公司率先实现半固态电池、“银河”全栈智能车解决方案、整车中央协调运动控制平台（VMC）等技术的量产落地，并推进全固态电池、高阶智能驾驶、一体化轻量智能底盘、AI智能座舱等前沿技术升级和上车应用。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"rm-01","text":"2025年公司实现合并营业总收入6562.4亿元，同比增长4.6%；营业收入646,152,101,889.30元，营业成本580,943,983,649.41元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004","source-0006"],"metrics":[{"name":"合并营业总收入","raw_value":"6562.4","value":"6562.4","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"合并营业总收入同比增长","raw_value":"4.6","value":"4.6","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"646,152,101,889.30","value":"646152101889.30","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业成本","raw_value":"580,943,983,649.41","value":"580943983649.41","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-02","text":"主营业务分产品收入：整车业务410,196,473,001.11元，毛利率4.30%；零部件业务203,019,866,775.26元，毛利率19.15%；劳务及其他32,935,762,112.94元，毛利率26.38%；金融业务10,091,710,191.88元，毛利率88.47%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"整车业务营业收入","raw_value":"410,196,473,001.11","value":"410196473001.11","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"整车业务毛利率","raw_value":"4.30","value":"4.30","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"零部件业务营业收入","raw_value":"203,019,866,775.26","value":"203019866775.26","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"零部件业务毛利率","raw_value":"19.15","value":"19.15","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"劳务及其他营业收入","raw_value":"32,935,762,112.94","value":"32935762112.94","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"劳务及其他毛利率","raw_value":"26.38","value":"26.38","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融业务营业收入","raw_value":"10,091,710,191.88","value":"10091710191.88","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融业务毛利率","raw_value":"88.47","value":"88.47","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-03","text":"主营业务分行业收入：汽车制造业646,152,101,889.30元，毛利率10.09%；金融业10,091,710,191.88元，毛利率88.47%；合计656,243,812,081.18元，毛利率11.30%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"汽车制造业营业收入","raw_value":"646,152,101,889.30","value":"646152101889.30","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"汽车制造业毛利率","raw_value":"10.09","value":"10.09","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融业营业收入","raw_value":"10,091,710,191.88","value":"10091710191.88","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融业毛利率","raw_value":"88.47","value":"88.47","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务合计营业收入","raw_value":"656,243,812,081.18","value":"656243812081.18","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务合计毛利率","raw_value":"11.30","value":"11.30","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-04","text":"主营业务分地区收入：中国504,138,835,950.64元，毛利率10.82%；其他地区152,104,976,130.54元，毛利率12.88%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"中国地区营业收入","raw_value":"504,138,835,950.64","value":"504138835950.64","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"中国地区毛利率","raw_value":"10.82","value":"10.82","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他地区营业收入","raw_value":"152,104,976,130.54","value":"152104976130.54","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他地区毛利率","raw_value":"12.88","value":"12.88","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-05","text":"2025年归属于上市公司股东的净利润101.1亿元，同比增长506.5%；扣除非经常性损益的净利润74.2亿元，同比增长237.2%。","subject_scope":"issuer","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"归属于上市公司股东的净利润","raw_value":"101.1","value":"101.1","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"issuer","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于上市公司股东的净利润同比增长","raw_value":"506.5","value":"506.5","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"issuer","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"扣除非经常性损益的净利润","raw_value":"74.2","value":"74.2","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"issuer","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"扣除非经常性损益的净利润同比增长","raw_value":"237.2","value":"237.2","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"issuer","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-06","text":"贸易业务本期营业收入206,508,725.66元，主要系汽车芯片及相关汽车零部件的出口贸易业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"贸易业务营业收入","raw_value":"206,508,725.66","value":"206508725.66","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"sm-01","text":"2025年公司整车销售450.7万辆，同比增长12.3%，市场占有率13.1%，同比上升0.3个百分点。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"整车销售","raw_value":"450.7","value":"450.7","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"整车销售同比增长","raw_value":"12.3","value":"12.3","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"市场占有率","raw_value":"13.1","value":"13.1","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"市场占有率同比变动","raw_value":"0.3","value":"0.3","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"个百分点","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-02","text":"自主品牌销量292.8万辆，同比增长21.6%，占公司整体销量比重65%，同比提升约5个百分点。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"自主品牌销量","raw_value":"292.8","value":"292.8","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"自主品牌销量同比增长","raw_value":"21.6","value":"21.6","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"自主品牌占整体销量比重","raw_value":"65","value":"65","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"自主品牌占整体销量比重同比提升","raw_value":"约5","value":"5","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"个百分点","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"approximate"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-03","text":"新能源车销售164.3万辆，同比增长33.1%，高于全国新能源车市场平均增速近5个百分点；出口及海外市场销售107.1万辆，同比增长3.1%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"新能源车销量","raw_value":"164.3","value":"164.3","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源车销量同比增长","raw_value":"33.1","value":"33.1","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源车销量增速高于全国平均","raw_value":"近5","value":"5","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"个百分点","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"approximate"},{"name":"出口及海外市场销量","raw_value":"107.1","value":"107.1","unit":"万辆","source_unit":"万辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"出口及海外市场销量同比增长","raw_value":"3.1","value":"3.1","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-04","text":"产销量合计：生产量4,601,962辆，销售量4,507,518辆，库存量188,996辆；生产量同比增长14.82%，销售量同比增长12.32%，库存量同比增长98.92%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"生产量合计","raw_value":"4,601,962","value":"4601962","unit":"辆","source_unit":"辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"销售量合计","raw_value":"4,507,518","value":"4507518","unit":"辆","source_unit":"辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"库存量合计","raw_value":"188,996","value":"188996","unit":"辆","source_unit":"辆","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"生产量同比增长","raw_value":"14.82","value":"14.82","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"销售量同比增长","raw_value":"12.32","value":"12.32","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"库存量同比增长","raw_value":"98.92","value":"98.92","unit":"%","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-05","text":"按车型类别销量：基本乘用车2,175,039辆，SUV
